$schema-note: Source of truth for Nod's design system. Edit this file, then run `pnpm --filter @nod/design-tokens generate`. Units: px and ms.
name: Phosphor

bg.use: Page background: near-black with a green cast

line.use: Decorative panel outlines and dividers (not for controls)

lineStrong.use: Outlines of interactive controls; meets 3:1 against every surface

phosphor.use: Display text, titles, primary actions, focus ring, live status

textFaint.use: Disabled text only (exempt from contrast rules)

onPhosphor.use: Text on phosphor, amber or red fills

amber.use: Caution: external provenance, writes, dry-run, held

contrast.note: Pairs checked by the package tests. Text pairs need WCAG AA 4.5:1; non-text (control outlines, focus ring, icons) need 3:1.

body.value: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', 'Liberation Mono', monospace
body.use: All running text. A legible system monospace: no web font download.

display.use: Wordmark, clock, counts, section headings. Drawn from pixel-font.json as SVG; never for running text.

motion.note: All motion is cosmetic and is removed under prefers-reduced-motion, except countdowns, which tick in whole seconds.

glow.use: Display text and live status only

scanlineOpacity.use: Static CRT scanline overlay; off under reduced motion and high contrast

glasses.note: The G2 shows one hue at a few brightness levels. Map each color token to a level 0-15 (0 = off). Meaning carried by hue on the web (amber, red) must be carried by an icon, inversion or position on the glasses.

semantics.urgent: Inverted badge (level 15 fill, text off) plus the alert icon
semantics.caution: Outlined badge plus the mail or pencil icon
semantics.recommended: Star icon plus the default highlight; default-on-silence gets the countdown ring
semantics.focus: 2px outline at level 15, the same as on the web
